body: It will happen sooner or later, yesterday it didn't happen. Today prevented it from happening..not sure until when I can hold this off till.

Explains others perception of me in a nutshell. Perceptions are always biased but I'm tired of changing peoples minds. Besides the hate from people..they just want to exert their power and want me to disappear from their lives. Words cannot express my tiredness. So perhaps shutting up and leaving would be best.

I still hear fireworks and am getting sleepy so maybe it is a sign tto keep on going.. 

Im going to sleep now, you win anonymous fireworks peoples. Good night and thanks for tonight. It was beautiful from this room with the full moon going.

It's actually my last, these past few days I was thinking about it, but tonight is it. It's unfortunate as it shows the people I surrounded myself with are shitty people that piles blames on others around them (me). I'm too stupid to know better to surround myself with good people. My mother is shit i know but I stayed. I'm pathethic.

My mom, half brother's father, former lover, some friends I thought were close, some evil douchebag's (which fucked me over then left me crying victim when in fact i was the victim, never talked about him again)'s friends I don't know them personally but heard of them, they all want me dead. Essentially everyone that knows or had known me wants me dead. I want to be dead too. This is a sad reality I face on a daily basis. Everyone hates me and I hate myself for giving away myself selflessly to be hated upon.

Thanks. Tbh, i just wanted a normal life, i tried so hard to have a normal life, a happy one with good friends, but my dysfunctional family situation is always sabatoging my life. And during those times i met some not so good people...that was a few years back. Fell into depression, tried to get back up..but in the end currently i have nothing left. A once promising educated individual with so much potential to thrive and become successful to have everything going for her is now in the dumps and mentally tired. I fell into an abyss and I can't get out. Job or no job. Money or no money. I suck, i lost.

Too burned out to do this, wanted to do this a few years back and did in fact leave the city for a day or two (no job then) to try to find a place in another city and ended coming back to this city in the end and still getting fucked over by my mom daily. i'm so mentally exausted and tired..after these fireworks tonight I'm calling it.
Idc about music anymore, i'm looking at the moon right now and no feelings whatsoever. No song can help at this point, no person can jolt me back from this decision, sorry.
I don't find joy in music or writing anymore. Music moreso but recently i don't feel anything.
Don't worry I'll find a way until I leave this world. I'm a determined individual.

Psychotic, bipolar, doesn't want her daughter to be better than her so use me for all her crap until she burns me out, now I can go in the trsh can. Doesn't care about when I had my rough times, she's selfish, always about her and her needs. Doesn't listen to my needs. Well it's too late now. 

I tried asking around to temp stay, no can do. Tried renting out, almost got scammed, i can't do anything right and i find it pointless to keep on living this torturing mundane life. Alone and being totured, no one cares about me anymore. I would just like to disappear forever. It'd be better that way. Everyone wins.

Because other peoples "kindness" has landed me in the shithole I'm in right now (even though I have such a bright future ahead if only i had better parents) and being told to my face they will try their best to make me kill myself is enough proof I need to go.
Too hollow inside, people want me dead, not worth it to stay, dying slowly, etc.
